decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The ground and first floor side extensions would create an unacceptable sense of enclosure. loss of light and overbearing presence of built form impacting the enjoyment of the house and garden of 115 Cambridge Road contrary to Merton Local Plan (MLP) 2024-2037/28 Policy D12.3 Ensuring high quality design for all developments and Policy D12.4 Alterations and extensions to existing buildings, as well as the London Plan 2021 London Plan 2021 Policy D3 Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach and Policy D4 Delivering good design .

Reason : 2 - The first storey element of the side extension would cause harm to the character of the streetscene and the immediate area around the subject property contrary to Merton Local Plan (MLP) 2024-2037/28 Policy D12.3 Ensuring high quality design for all developments and Policy D12.4 Alterations and extensions to existing buildings, as well as the London Plan 2021 London Plan 2021 Policy D3 Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach and Policy D4 Delivering good design .

Reason : 3 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the NPPF, The London Borough of Merton  (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to development proposals focused on solutions. LBM works with applicants/agents in a positive and proactive manner by:
"	Offering a pre-application advice and duty desk service. 
"	Where possible, suggesting solutions to secure a successful outcome.
"	As appropriate, updating applicants/agents of any issues that may arise in the processing of their application.
In this instance:


The application was considered to be fundamentally contrary to the provisions of the Development Plan and the NPPF, and there were not considered to be any solutions to resolve this conflict. 
It is noted that the applicant/agent did not engage in any pre-application discussions.
description: APPLICATION FOR THE PROPOSED ERECTION OF A TWO-STOREY SIDE EXTENSION, SINGLE-STOREY REAR EXTENSION, AND ALTERATIONS TO THE DORMER, INCLUDING THE INSTALLATION OF ROOFLIGHTS AT THE FRONT AND REAR OF THE PROPERTY.
